# nemau_instance_group (Data Source)

An existing instance group, for referencing one Terraform does not manage. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an instance group that is managed elsewhere.
data "nemau_instance_group" "web" {
  id = "9b1e2f3a-4c5d-4e6f-8a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b"
}

output "web_instance_ids" {
  value = data.nemau_instance_group.web.instance_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The group's public id. Set it, or `name`.
- `name` (String) The group's name. It must match one group of the project. Set it, or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `desired_capacity` (Number) Members the group should run now.
- `flavor_id` (String) Flavor of the launch template, when it has one.
- `health_check` (String) Health check in use.
- `image_id` (String) Image of the launch template.
- `instance_count` (Number) Current number of members.
- `instance_ids` (List of String) Ids of the current members.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum members.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum members.
- `network_id` (String) Network of the members.
- `security_group_ids` (List of String) Security group ids of the members.
- `status` (String) State of the group.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet of the members.
- `template_version` (Number) Version of the launch template.
- `user_data_present` (Boolean) Whether the launch template carries a cloud-init document. The document itself is never returned.
